active_experiment.name: Concrete lived-detail vs generic quote/advice
active_experiment.one_variable: Increase/measure concrete busy-parent creator system details without changing more than one weekly content variable
success_signals: impressions relative to baseline and rolling average

latest_observation.summary: Concrete lived-detail creator-system posts still look like the best long-term fit, but the fresh June 18 batch is too early; the biggest signal remains earlier lived-detail/system posts with personal detail and utility.

notes: Seeded after Alan approved the closed but gated feedback-loop design.
Typefully social set 257912 is the source of scheduled/published drafts.
Typefully X analytics endpoint is available and returns post metrics with draft_id matches when possible.
XContent Calendar / X_Calendar_DB is the canonical Notion layer for Typefully-scheduled X posts and analytics.
MainDB is YouTube-only and must not be used for the AlanNotion X scheduling/analytics loop.
Typefully scheduling can be autonomous when the matching XContent Calendar record is created or updated.

notion.note: After Alan shared the integration, the X Content Calendar page is API-accessible. The embedded child_database block is X_Calendar_DB; use data_source_id for queries/updates.
